now_building.title: SFUGAG: fair graph learning
now_building.tagline: Source-free, label-free fair adaptation of a graph neural network. Paper under review.
bullets: Only a frozen source task encoder and a sensitive head cross from the source graph; on the target the method reads node features and edges only
My part: worked out the source-free, label-free fair adaptation approach and wrote the paper
Scored on accuracy, AUC and two fairness gaps (demographic parity, equalized odds), built with **PyTorch + PyTorch Geometric**

projects.name: SFUGAG
